supplied_hardware.const: three real rear cameras and one flash

reference_role.const: directional evidence for modern mature Transsion-like retail recognition; never geometry to copy

form_spine.const: tall large-screen soft-square slab with believable medium volume, flat central rail, softened contact edges, and one coherent rear transition

front_and_frame.const: flat display, visually even narrow bezels, centred small punch hole, coherent controls, openings, antenna breaks, and seams

rear_surface.const: quiet rigid peacock-teal rear whose broad surface does not act as a cultural graphic skin

main_camera.const: one visibly largest protected real lens

auxiliary_cameras.const: two smaller real lenses with unambiguous descending or paired hierarchy

flash.const: one clearly smaller functional element subordinate to every lens and intentionally aligned to the selected topology

spacing_logic.const: real hardware centres establish the composition; decoration never creates pseudo-hardware nodes

elevation.const: one coherent enclosure or carrier elevation plus protected lens rings

junction.const: one precise rigid-part seam, controlled step, or narrow shadow gap proves attachment

node_system.const: only the supplied lenses and flash act as geometric nodes

subordination.const: internal order clarifies the selected topology and hardware hierarchy rather than reshaping the outer enclosure into a cultural symbol

forbidden.const: no fake aperture, decorative dot, filler sensor, camera text, active display, ornamental light, hesitant triangular tail, or copied released-product signature

ordering_logic.const: node spacing, reflection, continuity, and geometric rhythm derived from real hardware and part boundaries

far.const: a modern mature camera architecture with no traditional-art first read

middle.const: precise hardware rhythm and balanced structural order

close.const: subtle geometric logic in a real hard-part boundary, facet, seam, or finish transition

illustration_limit.const: no Rangoli picture, floral rosette, colourful powder effect, traditional motif drawing, decorative skin, or cultural camera-island silhouette

substrate_logic.const: rear surface, camera zone, carriers, and frame read as compatible rigid parts

junction_logic.const: finish and material changes follow real or visibly credible rigid-part boundaries

reflectivity_hierarchy.const: optical glass high reflection, rings and camera carrier medium reflection, broad rear surface low reflection

dual_view.const: exactly two consistent views of one bare phone and one colourway: rear or rear-three-quarter primary and front secondary

comparison_consistency.const: all four studies share body, hardware, CMF, framing, projection character, occupancy, and lighting softness

background_separation.const: the backdrop differs from the phone in both luminance and hue
